title: Maximum Subarray
constraints: A subarray is non-empty and contains consecutive elements.

solutionApproaches.title: Enumerate Every Range
solutionApproaches.explanation: Accumulate the sum for every start and end index. It is a useful baseline, but too slow at the maximum input size.

solutionApproaches.title: Kadane's Algorithm
solutionApproaches.explanation: At each position, extend the current subarray or start fresh. Track the global maximum.
